title: US equity markets closed — Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (301 -> nyse.com/trade/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-06 with a browser User-Agent). Its 'Holidays & Trading Hours' table, headed 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028', carries the row verbatim: 'Martin Luther King, Jr. Day | Monday, January 19 | Monday, January 18 | Monday, January 17' -- i.e. 2027-01-18 -- and the same row is present a second time inside the page's embedded JSON cell payload. THE PROPOSAL'S 403 DID NOT REPRODUCE: the proposing ledger recorded nyse.com as HTTP 403 on 2026-09-06 and downgraded its prefix to EST: on that basis; the same URL returns 200 to a browser-UA fetcher today, so the block was a User-Agent artifact, not egress, and the prefix upgrades EST: -> NEWS: on the exchange's own table. Corroborated by two independent primaries re-fetched this session: federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, page stamped 'Last Update: July 8, 2026'), whose K.8 'Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.' row reads January 19 / January 18 / January 17 / January 15 / January 21 for 2026-2030; and sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule (HTTP 200, 298,899 bytes), whose 2027 US recommendation is a FULL fixed-income close on Monday, January 18, 2027 with NO early close on the preceding Friday. Reproduced independently by statute (5 U.S.C. 6103, third Monday in January: January 2027's Mondays are the 4th, 11th, 18th, 25th). WHY STILL ESTIMATE, and it is not doubt about the date: market-events-data.ts's source-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange holiday calendar (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:), which is the same reason all seven sibling closure entries in this calendar are estimate. Cboe publishes only a 2026 options holiday schedule today (cboe.com/about/hours/us-options/, HTTP 200, 386,016 bytes -- no 2027 table exists on it), so no OCC:-class 2027 primary is available to route around the gap. PROMOTION CRITERION (unchanged in substance, sharpened): an exchange-calendar prefix being added to the taxonomy, or Cboe publishing its 2027 options holiday schedule listing 2027-01-18. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: Canonical file written by this event's own initial research (2026-09-06), which read proposals/mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18.from-vix-expiration-2027-01-20.json first as the never-assessed-on-a-proposed-id rule requires; that proposal is now inert and stays where it is. EventKind has no member for an exchange-schedule event, so 'sector' is the least-wrong option rather than a right one -- inherited verbatim from the good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 / presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 / memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 class. WHAT THE RESEARCH CHANGED, all of it computed this session over 1998-2050: (1) MLK is one of EXACTLY THREE US market closures structurally locked inside the monthly-expiration window (the 15th-21st of the month) -- MLK (3rd Monday January), Washington's Birthday (3rd Monday February) and Juneteenth (June 19 observed), each 53/53 years; no other US closure ever lands in that window. (2) Because both fall in that window, MLK is ALWAYS either exactly 3 days after January expiration or exactly 4 days before it -- no other spacing is possible. 2027 draws +3 (MLK removes the first post-expiration session, so the unpin Monday becomes Tuesday 2027-01-19), which is the MAJORITY case at 31/53 years (58.5%), NOT a rarity. (3) The proposing ledger's headline -- that MLK 2027-01-18 sits in the hole between VX/Z6's and VX/F7's 30-day strips -- is correct as scoped to the nine listed contracts and is NOT a 2027 anomaly: an inter-strip hole opens whenever consecutive third Fridays are 35 days apart (221 of 635 month-pairs), and MLK lands in one in 23/53 years (43.4%), including 2025, 2026 and 2027 back to back. Impact LOW and structural: a closed session moves nothing by itself, and trade-playbooks.md + multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for holiday|mlk|martin luther|closure|three-day weekend|half-day|early close -- ZERO hits in both, so no house playbook can fire on this date in either direction. NOT a Good Friday: SIFMA recommends a full bond close on 2027-01-18 with no adjacent early close, so both asset classes are dark together and the cross-asset schedule asymmetry the good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 ledger found does NOT exist here. SEPARATELY OBSERVED, not this lane's file to touch: the calendar still carries both presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 and washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15 for one NYSE closure.
